name: Carl Cox: three-deck acapella layer
lesson:
## Two beats under, a voice on top

The full version of Cox's layering: A and B run together as in the two-deck drill, bass swapped at bar 17, and an acapella on a third deck starts on the one of bar 17 and rides over both until A leaves. On bars 31 and 32, A's cue stutters on eighths before it plays out.

The FLX4 has two channels, so this drill is flagged as needing a third deck: the acapella's fader and play button are not on this controller, and the lanes only show what your two hands do on decks A and B. What you are practising is keeping two full tracks level for 32 bars while the third element carries the room. A four-channel mixer or a second controller unlocks it.
